provenance: Original deterministic pixel clusters authored for Cinder from the user-directed permanent astronaut-like helmet and original generated turnaround reference. No stock-image pixels, concept crops, glow backgrounds or irregular generated cells are imported into runtime art.
palette_role: Ivory protective panels, cool silver seams, dark navy visor and subdued red trim are original game art direction; helmet and equipment keep one compatible expedition outfit.
role: Player actor and cosmetic equipment appearance; attack footprint is resolved by the shared player controller.
occlusion: Billboard quad uses normal world depth; contact shadow is a separate floor mesh. No foreground fade is part of this asset.
animation_clock: Action frames follow controller-owned visual progress from simulation time. Only idle breathing owns a local 1.2-second simulation loop. Cosmetics never resolve or delay damage, movement, cooldowns or queued weapon replacement.

clothing_visuals.implementation: Compatible neck rings, protective panels, reinforced cuffs/knees and boot connections share one48x64 family. Neutral and six static alternatives render from existing IDs. Exports show neutral clothing, while equipment-review includes the whole static subset and a mixed outfit.

limits: Four artwork facings depict exact continuous world aim; artwork never quantizes input.
Visual settling has separate clocks so added frames never change accepted hit timing, dash length, cooldowns or swap eligibility.
The blade and short barrel blast remain appearances of one carried weapon profile, not two equipment slots.
Enemy24x32 arena art remains a coarser prototype while this deliberately authored player production pass retains the same world footprint.
Physical-phone brightness, finger occlusion, performance, human balance and campaign scenery remain untested.

helmet.states: every facing, action and equipment combination
helmet.source_native_shell: rounded stepped silhouette, dark visor/rim, neck seal and rear catches

review.helmet_compatibility: passed source sheets and actual portrait inspection; permanent shell stays visible
review.mixed_outfit_compatibility: passed all 13 implemented static item appearances plus one mixed kit across every state and facing
review.facing_readability: front/side dark visor and rim versus rear pale shell/seam; inspected at 270x585 gameplay raster and540x1170 portrait output

identifier_note: Existing PLAYER-ASTRONOMER-W01..W04 IDs and astronomer-weapon PNG names are retained for stable references; their artwork is now permanently helmeted.
